cron_jobs.name: daily-tech-feed
cron_jobs.message: Run this exact command, nothing else: bash /app/scripts/daily_pipeline.sh
cron_jobs.description: Every day at 6 PM ET — runs the daily pipeline script (newsletter fetch, blog fetch, PDF generation, NLM notebook + report + podcast, magazine PDF, RAG indexing, Telegram delivery).

cron_jobs.name: weekly-research-digest
cron_jobs.message: Run this exact command, nothing else: bash /app/scripts/weekly_pipeline.sh
cron_jobs.description: Every Saturday at 9 AM ET — runs the weekly pipeline script (newsletter fetch, blog monitor, triage, content processing, NLM orchestrator, news digest, delivery).

setup_commands: openclaw cron add --name "daily-tech-feed" --cron "0 18 * * *" --tz "America/New_York" --session isolated --message "Run this exact command, nothing else: bash /app/scripts/daily_pipeline.sh" --announce --channel telegram

openclaw cron add --name "weekly-research-digest" --cron "0 9 * * 6" --tz "America/New_York" --session isolated --message "Run this exact command, nothing else: bash /app/scripts/weekly_pipeline.sh" --announce --channel telegram
